title: Polygonal Refractive Outer Billiards
summary: Extending recent work on refractive billiards, we introduce and study the corresponding refractive outer billiards system about a convex polygon. Gutkin and Simanyi showed in 1992 that for regular outer billiards, orbits about a certain class of polygons called quasi-rational polygons are bounded, and that orbits about rational polygons are periodic. Tabachnikov and Culter later proved in 2007 that every outer billiard system about a convex polygon admits a periodic trajectory. We generalize both results to the refractive setting.
